artifacts.notes: OracleTestVMs OpenBSD 7.8 FVWM lease lease-20260506205333-u7tgwm rebuilt this headless package against the native OpenBSD GNUstep/libobjc2 runtime under /usr/local. The OpenBSD package build replaces Arlen's dispatch_once-only libdispatch usage with a local pthread-backed shim, so installed package executables do not load libdispatch/libBlocksRuntime and do not emit the libBlocksRuntime/libobjc2 symbol-size warning.

packages.name: tools-xctest
packages.summary: XCTest runner and harness for native GNUstep Objective-C unit tests.

source.channel_policy: stable tracks a tagged danjboyd/tools-xctest release, pinned by tag and commit, under the maintainer's fork-pin exception (AIManager ask #3024). The fork is 212 commits past upstream master 5c84fc3 and converges upstream piece by piece.
source.provides_natively_notes: v0.8.0 and later implement Apple-style -only-testing:/-skip-testing: itself (fork CHANGELOG 0.2-0.4), so the downstream patch that added them is no longer carried. The package build still checks that xctest --help lists both filters.
